variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: High fidelity desktop web page mockup for Coliclic trip details.
Input image 1: mobile visual reference only; adapt into a NEW wide desktop composition, not a stretched mobile screenshot.
Composition: landscape screenshot target visual viewport 1440 by 1000, front-facing flat UI, no device hardware, no browser chrome, no phone status bar. One design only. French interface. Centered max-width content around 1200px with generous margins. Preserve visual DNA of reference: white cards and WHITE itinerary surface, very pale gray #FAFAFA background, deep navy #023047 headings, orange #FB8500 primary button, pale blue small icon disks, light gray hairline borders, restrained shadows, rounded corners, DM Sans/Poppins-style readable typography. Absolutely NO large navy or blue background or gradients, no hero photographs or maps.
Use a consistent header in every design: white bar, Coliclic wordmark at left (Coli orange, clic navy), middle nav "Comment ça marche", "Trouver un trajet", "Transporter un colis", right "Connexion". Main content starts with subtle "← Retour aux résultats", then "Détail du trajet" small and a large "Paris → Abidjan".
Required exact sample data: "Départ", "Jeudi 12 novembre 2026", "10:30", "Paris (CDG)"; "Arrivée", "Jeudi 12 novembre 2026", "17:00", "Abidjan (ABJ)". Traveler block: "Voyageuse", "Aminata K.", "★ 4,9 · 24 avis", small circular portrait matching reference, "Voir le profil". Capacity: "15 kg disponibles". Price: "12 €/kg", "Prix par kilo". Conditions block "À savoir": "Sur accord du voyageur" with sentence "Votre demande de réservation sera soumise au voyageur."; "Remise à convenir" with sentence "Les détails de la remise du colis seront discutés avec le voyageur." Must show prominent orange button EXACT "Réserver".
This is parcel delivery through travelers, not passenger transport. No extra features, no verification badge, no insurance, no payment promise, no review quotes, no weight input or checkout, no invented availability urgency. All required content must fit the landscape composition clearly, no clipped text or placeholders.
Layout 1 CLASSIC TWO COLUMNS. Main left column about 760px: a large white itinerary card with vertical timeline, dates and times, followed by a wide traveler profile row card and a white conditions card. Right column 350px: standalone booking summary card aligned to top of itinerary, large 12 €/kg, 15 kg disponibles with icon, subtle separator, full-width orange Réserver. Balanced compact card heights so the full content fits. White breathing space below booking summary. No bottom booking bar.
